# Fiction & Fact Library

> Free reading and English tools for students in grades 2–8 (ages about 7–14) and their teachers: twelve interactive tools, each with a short lesson, a printable one-page worksheet and a teacher answer key. Everything runs in the browser with no sign-up and no ads. The site also has Listen, a player for free public-domain audiobooks read by LibriVox volunteers. From the makers of Interactive Periodic Table.

## Tools

- [Reading Tools: Free Interactive Practice for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/): Free interactive reading tools for grades 2–8, each with a printable worksheet and a teacher answer key. They run in the browser with no sign-up or ads.
- [Cause and Effect Game: Free Practice for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/cause-and-effect/): Free cause and effect game for grades 2–8: tap the cause or the effect, spot signal words, match pairs and follow a chain of events. With examples.
- [Context Clues Game: Free Practice for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/context-clues/): Free context clues game for grades 2–8: work out what a word means from definition, synonym, antonym, example and inference clues. With examples.
- [Fables Read-Along: Aesop’s Fables Read Aloud, with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/): Ten of Aesop’s fables for grades 2–5, read aloud in your browser with each sentence highlighted, then questions on the story and its moral. Free.
- [Fact or Opinion Game: Free Practice for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fact-or-opinion/): Free fact or opinion game for grades 2–8: sort statements, learn the clue words and find the opinion inside a sentence. With fact vs opinion examples.
- [Fiction or Nonfiction Game: Free Practice, Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fiction-or-nonfiction/): Free fiction or nonfiction game for grades 2–8: sort passages and book descriptions, learn the clues and name 13 genres. With examples and a genre guide.
- [Figurative Language Game: Simile, Metaphor & More](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/figurative-language/): Free figurative language game for grades 3–8: spot similes, metaphors, personification, hyperbole and idioms. Every answer is explained, with examples.
- [Main Idea and Details Game: Free Practice, Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/main-idea/): Free main idea game for grades 2–8: read a short paragraph, choose the main idea, then sort the supporting details from the sentences that do not belong.
- [Parts of Speech Game: Free Grammar Practice, Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/parts-of-speech/): Free parts of speech game for grades 2–8: tap the nouns and verbs, name the highlighted word, or color a whole sentence. Every word is explained.
- [Plot Diagram Builder: Free Story Mountain Maker](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/plot-diagram/): Free plot diagram maker: build a story mountain for any story, with exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution. Print it or share it.
- [Reading Level Checker: Free Readability & Grade Level Tool](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/reading-level/): Free reading level checker: paste any text to see its grade level, age range, Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch–Kincaid score. Nothing you type is saved.
- [Reading Speed Test: Free Words per Minute Test with Quiz](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/reading-speed/): Free reading speed test for grades 2–8: time yourself on a short passage, see your words per minute, then answer five questions to check you understood.
- [Prefix and Suffix Word Builder: Free Tool for Grades 2–8](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/word-builder/): Free prefix and suffix word builder for grades 2–8: add parts to a base word, see the spelling change and learn what prefixes, suffixes and roots mean.
- [The Ant and the Grasshopper: Read-Along Fable with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/ant-and-grasshopper/): Read along with The Ant and the Grasshopper, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The Boy Who Cried Wolf: Read-Along Fable with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/boy-who-cried-wolf/): Read along with The Boy Who Cried Wolf, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The Crow and the Pitcher: Read-Along Fable with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/crow-and-pitcher/): Read along with The Crow and the Pitcher, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The Dog and His Reflection: Read-Along Fable with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/dog-and-his-reflection/): Read along with The Dog and His Reflection, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The Fox and the Grapes: Read-Along Fable with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/fox-and-grapes/): Read along with The Fox and the Grapes, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The Goose That Laid the Golden Eggs: Read-Along Fable](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/goose-and-golden-eggs/): Read along with The Goose That Laid the Golden Eggs, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The Lion and the Mouse: Read-Along Fable with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/lion-and-mouse/): Read along with The Lion and the Mouse, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The North Wind and the Sun: Read-Along Fable with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/north-wind-and-sun/): Read along with The North Wind and the Sun, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The Tortoise and the Hare: Read-Along Fable with Questions](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/tortoise-and-hare/): Read along with The Tortoise and the Hare, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse: Read-Along Fable](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/town-mouse-and-country-mouse/): Read along with The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse, an Aesop fable for grades 2–5: hear it read aloud with highlighted text, then answer five questions.
- [Plot Diagram of Cinderella: Story Mountain Example](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/plot-diagram/examples/cinderella/): See the plot diagram of Cinderella: its exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution on a story mountain, with each event explained.
- [Plot Diagram of Goldilocks and the Three Bears: Story Mountain](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/plot-diagram/examples/goldilocks-and-the-three-bears/): Plot diagram of Goldilocks and the Three Bears: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution on a story mountain, each explained.
- [Plot Diagram of Jack and the Beanstalk: Story Mountain Example](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/plot-diagram/examples/jack-and-the-beanstalk/): Plot diagram of Jack and the Beanstalk: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution on a story mountain, each explained.
- [Plot Diagram of Little Red Riding Hood: Story Mountain Example](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/plot-diagram/examples/little-red-riding-hood/): Plot diagram of Little Red Riding Hood: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution on a story mountain, each explained.
- [Plot Diagram of The Three Little Pigs: Story Mountain Example](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/plot-diagram/examples/three-little-pigs/): Plot diagram of The Three Little Pigs: the exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution on a story mountain, with each event explained.
- [Plot Diagram of The Tortoise and the Hare: Story Mountain Example](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/plot-diagram/examples/tortoise-and-the-hare/): Plot diagram of The Tortoise and the Hare: exposition, rising action, climax, falling action and resolution on a story mountain, each explained.

## Classroom

- [For Teachers: Free Reading Worksheets & Answer Keys](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/teachers/): Free reading tools for grades 2–8 with printable one-page worksheets, teacher answer keys and short lesson plans. No logins, no ads, Chromebook-ready.
- [Cause and Effect Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–6](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/cause-and-effect/activity/): Free printable cause and effect worksheet for grades 3–6: mark the cause and effect in eight sentences, match five pairs and draw a chain. With answer key.
- [Context Clues Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–6](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/context-clues/activity/): Free printable context clues worksheet for grades 3–6: find the clue in eight sentences, write each meaning and name the type of clue. With answer key.
- [Fable Worksheet: The Lion and the Mouse, Free Printable](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fables/activity/): Free printable fable worksheet for grades 2–5: read The Lion and the Mouse, answer four questions, put the moral in your own words and write a new ending.
- [Fact or Opinion Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–6](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fact-or-opinion/activity/): Free printable fact or opinion worksheet for grades 3–6: sort ten statements, find the opinion inside four sentences and write your own. With answer key.
- [Fiction or Nonfiction Worksheet: Free Printable](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/fiction-or-nonfiction/activity/): Free printable fiction or nonfiction worksheet for grades 2–5: sort ten items, name the clue that gave each one away and write your own. With answer key.
- [Figurative Language Worksheet: Free Printable](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/figurative-language/activity/): Free printable figurative language worksheet for grades 4–6: label ten sentences, write a simile and a metaphor and explain two idioms. With answer key.
- [Main Idea Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–6](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/main-idea/activity/): Free printable main idea worksheet for grades 3–6: find the topic, the main idea and three details in two paragraphs, then write a main idea sentence.
- [Parts of Speech Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–6](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/parts-of-speech/activity/): Free printable parts of speech worksheet for grades 3–6: mark nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs in eight sentences, sort twelve words. With answer key.
- [Story Mountain Worksheet: Blank Plot Diagram to Print](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/plot-diagram/activity/): Free printable plot diagram worksheet for grades 3–6: place the events of a fable on a story mountain, then fill in a blank mountain for your own story.
- [Reading Level Worksheet: Rewrite for a Younger Reader](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/reading-level/activity/): Free printable reading level worksheet for grades 4–8: students check a passage, record the numbers, rewrite it for a younger reader and check it again.
- [Fluency Record Sheet: Free Printable for Timed Reading](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/reading-speed/activity/): Free printable fluency record sheet for grades 3–6: a passage with word counts in the margin, a table for three timed readings and reflection questions.
- [Prefix and Suffix Worksheet: Free Printable, Grades 3–5](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/tools/word-builder/activity/): Free printable prefix and suffix worksheet for grades 3–5: break eight words into parts, build six words from a part bank and match prefixes. With key.

## Listen

- [Listen: Free Classic Audiobooks Read Aloud Online](https://fictionandfactlibrary.com/listen/): Listen to free public-domain audiobooks online: classic stories, poems and non-fiction read aloud by LibriVox volunteers. No sign-up, nothing to install.
